description: Downloads a publicly reachable image or video URL into the user's Feedlio media library and returns its uid, which can then be passed to create_post.media_uids. This is the only way to add media through MCP — files cannot be uploaded from chat; ask the user for a public URL (or to upload in the dashboard and use list_media).

name.description: Optional display name for the file

url.description: Publicly reachable http(s) URL of the image/video

name: add_media_from_url
title: Add an image/video to the media library from a URL
